sourceWindow: Exact3-test-file source/pure-validation work completed; released to root after this receipt. No further source changes without root authorization.
changes: All4 independent original control contexts/geometries/destinations/DOM+2RAF unchanged. Public observer attaches afterwards with exactly{onFrame}; require original page.video beforehand; no private API/CDP/path/size/quality/overlay/pin/SDK/config/production changes.

One absolute10000ms failure deadline includes start/readiness/decode and stop. Explicit elapsed-time checks reject late completion even before timer delivery. Startconfirmation AND qualifiedframe required; cached callback cannot bypass deferred/rejected start.

Callback is synchronous: only bound check/copy/schedule; actual decoder and subprocess setup are deferred to microtask. One active ownedJPEG, no queue/latest. Busy callbacks are dropped.400candidate cap and encoded/decoded32MiB bounds.

Sequential stdin/stdout-only ffprobe validates actual JPEGwidth/height positive safeinteger<=recordingcanvas; ffmpeg uses exact installed pad=W:H:0:0:gray,crop=W:H:0:0, no scale or ignoredpixels. Metadata and ownedRGB/JPEG are cleared; borrowed SDKbuffer is never mutated.
Readiness uses sameframe unchanged exactclassifier NONBLANK+maxRowRuns>6/tol12. Final whole originalautomaticWebM classifier/atleastone/finalframe assertions remain byte-equivalent and authoritative.

Timeout/close/crash/cancel/error sets inert state; aborts decoder, closes context as kNoTimeout fallback, consumes late start/stop/rejections, stops partiallyattached and latestarted observer, awaits active decoder/resourceclose before claiming joined. Cleanup error remains red; existing nestedcontext/profile/root finally retained.
Numericfixedphase/errorfacts only in control-readiness.json; original probeprofile/media remain temporary and removed. Sourceobservation is labeled controlSynchronizationOnly, never video proof.

resourceBoundsAndLimits.nativeToolOutput: bounded allocation plus current pipechunk; overrun stops pipes, sendsSIGKILL, and rejects only after childclose
resourceBoundsAndLimits.cleanupConfirmation: No success/decoderJoined until observed promise/childclose completion; no claim SIGKILL itself confirms exit. Context closure is kNoTimeout fallback; if SDKstart/stop/contextclose or OSchildclose never settles, existing120000ms outerfixtureguard remains; no hardOS cancellation bound claimed.
resourceBoundsAndLimits.memory: Only ownedcopies zeroed and references released; no guarantee of GC/OScryptographic erasure. Original SDKbuffers never zeroed.
resourceBoundsAndLimits.timing: Observer intentionally changes isolated control scheduling and video duration, adds IPC/copy/decoding overhead; not timing-neutral. Original production origin/calibration/<=500ms timingoracles untouched.
resourceBoundsAndLimits.platform: Uses existing installed ffprobe/ffmpeg and pinned Playwright1.63.0 public sharedscreencast behavior; pure tests use injectedfakeports, not native runtime. Fresh localnative proof still required; deployed/internal image provenance remains external.
